the-president-stays-in.summary: In this world, the voters I interviewed lean 0.0 points further toward Trump than the same people did in 2024 as it was. Wisconsin flips, but Trump still wins, 302–236. The closest call is Michigan, which holds for Trump by 0.5 points. Harris wins in 9 of 100 draws. Extremely low confidence. Historical evidence is thin: loose analogies or weak sources only.
assumptions: The nominee on the Democratic line is the 82-year-old incumbent President rather than his actual replacement; his age and debate performance weigh on voters' views, and baseline party loyalty and turnout shift accordingly.
howIGotThis: What changed: The President does not withdraw, and remains the nominee of the party that has held the White House since 2021 through election day.
I built this change from your words. It is exploratory, not part of the plan fixed before any run.

What historians found (11 findings, weak evidence): No actual outcome exists for Biden staying in; he withdrew July 21, 2024. Pre-withdrawal polls show high age concerns, shaky Democratic loyalty and a small, growing Trump lead. Analogues (FDR 1944, Humphrey 1968) are loose and carry no group breakdowns.
The numbers: the 2020 census counts carried forward to 2024 and certified returns; every draw reproduces 2024 exactly before the change.
How sure: I reran it 100 times with different population and parameter draws.
